classification: Single-variable read-pool experiment; only an actual full-suite run can establish a new suite score
required_environment: Previously prepared dedicated AWS host with frozen decimal SF10K dataset, engine artifacts, selected-cases-before-q11.json and critical oracle/selection receipts. This incremental diagnostic entrypoint is not a clean-host bootstrap.
measurement_boundary: A phases use 32 KvikIO threads per executor; B phases and the optional suite phase use 8; C1 is a separate single screening probe with 16. Each application starts new executors, and all eight native pools are verified from live thread names and startup messages. Host/VM/GPM/pool observers are identical; no kernel profiling or cache flushing. All other Spark settings, SQL and engine artifacts are fixed.
hardware_boundary: GPU GPM counters and stage timing are observed. CPU memory bandwidth, shared PCIe/UPI link saturation and matched-access-pattern storage bandwidth ceilings are not measured.
retention: AWS instance retained until explicit user release
